title: Sports
about: Names of sports: ball games like football and tennis, and other sports like swimming, skiing and judo. Where we do sports, and how to talk about them with play, go and do.

parts.title: Play, go or do?
parts.note: З іграми з м'ячем кажуть play: play tennis. З видами спорту на -ing із частини B — go: go swimming, went skiing. З judo і karate — do: She does judo. Детальніше про go / went / gone — у юніті 39.

rows: ball games: football, tennis, basketball, volleyball…
sports with -ing: swimming, running, sailing, skiing, kayaking…
judo, karate (and do sport / do sports)

items.pattern: play football · a football match / team
items.meaning: a game where two teams kick a round ball and try to get it into a goal
items.example: My brother plays **football** with his friends after school.
more: We watched a **football** match on TV on Saturday.
Which **football** team do you like?
items.watchOut: Зазвичай кажуть play football — без the і без in: не play in football. В американській англійській цей футбол часто називають soccer.

items.pattern: play rugby · a rugby team / ball
items.meaning: a game where players kick, carry and throw an oval ball
items.example: Our school **rugby** team plays every Wednesday.
more: In **rugby**, you can run with the ball in your hands.
**Rugby** players often get very muddy in winter.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈrʌɡbi/ — «рагбі», а не «регбі».

items.pattern: play American football
items.meaning: a game from the USA; players wear helmets and carry an oval ball
items.example: In **American football**, the players wear big helmets.
more: My cousin in Texas plays **American football** at school.
**American football** is very popular in the USA.
items.watchOut: Американці кажуть про цю гру просто football. У Британії football — це звичайний футбол, тому там кажуть American football.

items.pattern: play basketball · a basketball team / player
items.meaning: a game where players throw a ball into a high net called a basket
items.example: We play **basketball** in the school gym.
more: My sister is in the school **basketball** team.
Can I borrow your **basketball**? Mine is flat.
items.watchOut: Basketball — це і гра, і сам м'яч: a basketball.

items.pattern: play badminton · a badminton racket
items.meaning: a game where you hit a light thing with feathers (a shuttlecock) over a high net with a racket
items.example: We play **badminton** in the garden in summer.
more: You need a racket and a shuttlecock for **badminton**.
Is **badminton** easier than tennis?

items.pattern: play baseball · a baseball bat / cap
items.meaning: a game from the USA; you hit a ball with a long bat and then run
items.example: My uncle wears a **baseball** cap every day.
more: We watched a **baseball** game in New York.
**Baseball** is very popular in Japan too.

items.pattern: play tennis · a tennis racket / ball / lesson
items.meaning: a game for two or four players who hit a ball over a net with rackets
items.example: Let's play **tennis** on Saturday morning.
more: She has a **tennis** lesson every Tuesday.
I need some new **tennis** balls.
items.watchOut: Пишеться з двома n: tennis. Кажуть play tennis, не play in tennis.

items.pattern: play volleyball · beach volleyball
items.meaning: a game where two teams hit a ball over a high net with their hands
items.example: In summer we play **volleyball** on the beach.
more: Our **volleyball** team won every game this year.
In **volleyball**, you can't catch the ball.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈvɒlibɔːl/ — «волібол», а не «волейбол».

items.pattern: play table tennis · a table tennis bat / table
items.meaning: a game where you hit a small light ball over a low net on a table with a bat
items.example: Grandpa and I play **table tennis** in the garage.
more: You need a bat and a small white ball for **table tennis**.
The **table tennis** ball rolled under the sofa.
items.watchOut: Ракетку для настільного тенісу британці зазвичай називають a bat, а не a racket. У розмові гру ще називають ping-pong.

items.pattern: go swimming · swim – swam – swum
items.meaning: moving through water using your arms and legs
items.example: We **go swimming** every Sunday morning.
more: **Swimming** is good for your back.
Can you swim? I learned when I was five.
items.watchOut: «Ходити плавати» — go swimming. Не go to swimming. Go on swimming означає «плавати далі, не зупинятися».

items.pattern: go running · run – ran – run
items.meaning: moving fast on your feet, as a sport
items.example: My mum **goes running** in the park before work.
more: **Running** in the rain is fun!
I need new trainers for **running**.
items.watchOut: Пишеться з двома n: running. «Бігати» як спорт — go running.

items.pattern: go sailing · a sailing boat
items.meaning: travelling on water in a boat with sails, for sport or fun
items.example: We **went sailing** on the lake in the summer holidays.
more: You need wind for **sailing**.
My uncle has a small boat. He often takes us **sailing**.

items.pattern: watch motor racing · a motor racing driver
items.meaning: a sport where people drive very fast cars around a track
items.example: My dad watches **motor racing** on TV every Sunday.
more: The cars in **motor racing** can go over 300 kilometres an hour.
She wants to be a **motor racing** driver one day.
items.watchOut: Британською — motor racing, американською часто auto racing.

items.pattern: watch horse racing · go to the horse racing
items.meaning: a sport where people ride horses in a race
items.example: Lots of people come to watch **horse racing** in the spring.
more: The riders in **horse racing** are usually small and light.
My grandad likes **horse racing**, but he can't ride.

items.pattern: do judo / do karate · a judo / karate class
items.meaning: sports from Japan where you use your hands, feet and body in special fighting moves
items.example: My little brother **does karate** after school.
more: She **does judo** twice a week and she's very strong.
We wear white clothes in our **judo** class.
items.watchOut: З judo і karate кажуть do: I do karate. Не play karate і не go karate. Вимова: judo — «джудоу», karate — «карАті», наголос на другому складі.

items.pattern: go snowboarding · a snowboard
items.meaning: going down a snowy mountain standing on one wide board
items.example: My cousin **goes snowboarding** in the Carpathians every winter.
more: **Snowboarding** is harder than it looks!
You need warm clothes and a helmet for **snowboarding**.

items.pattern: go skiing · ski – skied · skis
items.meaning: moving over snow on two long, thin boards called skis
items.example: We **went skiing** in the mountains last winter.
more: Is **skiing** expensive?
My grandma still goes **skiing** every year.
items.watchOut: «Кататися на лижах» — go skiing, а не ride skis. Пишеться з двома i: skiing.

items.pattern: go kayaking · a kayak
items.meaning: travelling on a river or lake in a small, narrow boat that you move with a paddle
items.example: We **went kayaking** on the river last summer.
more: You must wear a life jacket for **kayaking**.
We saw lots of ducks when we were **kayaking** on the lake.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈkaɪækɪŋ/ — «кАйякінг», наголос на першому складі.

items.pattern: a tennis / badminton / volleyball / basketball court · on a court
items.meaning: a flat area with lines where you play tennis, basketball and similar games
items.example: We played tennis on the new **court** behind the school.
more: The basketball **court** in our park has new lines.
The volleyball players are walking onto the **court**.
items.watchOut: Баскетбольний майданчик — a basketball court, не a basketball playground. Грають on a court (on, не in). Вимова: /kɔːt/, без «р».

items.pattern: a football / rugby pitch · on the pitch
items.meaning: a big area of grass where you play football or rugby
items.example: The **pitch** was too wet, so we didn't play the match.
more: Our school has two football **pitches**.
Fans can't walk on the **pitch** during the game.
items.watchOut: У Британії футбольне поле — a football pitch; field теж кажуть, особливо в США. Stadium — це вся споруда з трибунами, а не саме поле.

items.pattern: a swimming pool · in the pool
items.meaning: a place with a lot of clean water where people swim
items.example: The new **swimming pool** in our town has a big slide.
more: The water in the **swimming pool** is very cold today!
Please don't run near the **swimming pool**.
items.watchOut: Басейн — swimming pool або просто pool. Не basin: basin — це миска або умивальник. Плавати в басейні — swim in the pool.

items.pattern: a sports centre · at the sports centre
items.meaning: a building where you can do lots of different sports
items.example: The **sports centre** has a pool, a gym and two courts.
more: Our **sports centre** is closed on Sundays.
Let's meet outside the **sports centre** at five.
items.watchOut: Кажуть sports centre — sports у множині. Британською centre, американською center.

items.pattern: Do you do any sports? — Yes, I … / No, I don't.
items.meaning: a question to find out if someone does sport
items.example: **Do you do any sports?** — Yes, I play volleyball.
more: — **Do you do any sports?** — Not really, but I walk the dog every day.
The PE teacher asked everyone, '**Do you do any sports** after school?'
items.watchOut: Займатися спортом — do sport / do sports, не make sport. Вираз go in for sports зі старих підручників сьогодні звучить старомодно.

items.pattern: play + ball game (no the) · Which sports do you play?
items.meaning: use play with ball games
items.example: We **play basketball** at the weekend.
more: Which sports **do you play**?
We **played volleyball** on the beach all afternoon.
items.watchOut: «Грати у футбол» — play football: без in і без the. Не play in football, не play the football.

items.pattern: go + sport with -ing · went skiing
items.meaning: use go with sports that end in -ing
items.uk: ходити плавати / бігати, їздити кататися на лижах
items.example: I **go running** every morning before school.
more: Last summer we **went kayaking** in the mountains.
Do you want to **go swimming** with us on Saturday?
items.watchOut: Після go — просто слово на -ing: go swimming. Не go to swimming і не go on swimming.

items.pattern: What's your favourite sport? — My favourite sport is …
items.meaning: a question about the sport you like more than all the others
items.example: **What's your favourite sport?** — Basketball. I play it every day.
more: My **favourite sport** is swimming.
Tennis is my dad's **favourite sport**.
items.watchOut: Британською favourite (з u), американською favorite. «Вид спорту» зазвичай не перекладають окремо: просто favourite sport.

items.pattern: I like + sport + best · Which sport do you like best?
items.meaning: I like it more than all the others
items.example: I like swimming and running, but I **like skiing best**.
more: Which sport do you **like best**?
My sister likes skiing, but I **like snowboarding best**.
items.watchOut: Best стоїть у кінці: I like tennis best. Не I best like tennis і не I like the most tennis.

warmup.explain: З karate і judo кажуть do: he does karate.
Go + слово на -ing, без to: go swimming.
Play tennis — без in і без the.
Басейн — swimming pool. Basin — миска або умивальник.

warmup.uk: Діти грають у футбол на полі.
warmup.q: The children are playing football on the ___.
warmup.explain: Футбольне поле — a pitch. Pool — басейн, stadium — уся споруда.

warmup.uk: Минулої зими ми їздили кататися на лижах.
warmup.explain: Кататися на лижах — go skiing, у минулому — went skiing.

C.q: You can swim, play badminton and do judo in one building, the ___.

example.title: A busy sports weekend
example.uk:
Наша родина любить спорт. У суботу вранці ми з татом ходили на пробіжку в парк. Потім ми зустрілися з друзями у спортивному центрі.

Спочатку ми грали в бадмінтон на маленькому корті. Після цього ми стрибнули в басейн. Моя подруга Оля займається карате, тож вона показала нам кілька прийомів.

У неділю мій брат грав у футбол на шкільному полі. Його команда виграла! Увечері дідусь запитав мене: «Який твій улюблений вид спорту?» Я відповіла: «Мені подобаються всі, але найбільше я люблю плавання».
example.en:
My family loves sport. On Saturday morning, Dad and I [[went running|b2]] in the park. Then we met my friends at the [[sports centre|c4]].

First we played [[badminton|a5]] on a small [[court|c1]]. After that, we jumped into the [[swimming pool|c3]]. My friend Ola [[does karate|b6]], so she showed us some moves.

On Sunday, my brother played [[football|a1]] on the school [[pitch|c2]]. His team won! In the evening, Grandpa asked me, "[[What's your favourite sport?|d4]]" I said, "I like them all, but I [[like swimming best|d5]]."
